title: सप्तसप्तत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 277 · Sagara and the sage Arishtanemi

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks how a king like himself may rule and yet be free, and by what qualities a man is freed from the snare of attachment. Bhishma tells how King Sagara asked the sage Arishtanemi, who taught him that a man is born and grows and meets his end by himself, and that the contented man in this world is already free.
summary.kn: ತನ್ನಂತಹ ರಾಜ ಆಳುತ್ತಲೂ ಹೇಗೆ ಮುಕ್ತನಾಗಬಹುದು, ಯಾವ ಗುಣಗಳಿಂದ ಆಸಕ್ತಿಯ ಪಾಶದಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ರಾಜ ಸಗರ ಋಷಿ ಅರಿಷ್ಟನೇಮಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮನುಷ್ಯ ತಾನೇ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ಸಾಯುತ್ತಾನೆ, ತೃಪ್ತನೇ ಮುಕ್ತ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि उन जैसा राजा शासन करते हुए भी मुक्त कैसे रहे और किन गुणों से आसक्ति के पाश से छूटे। भीष्म राजा सगर के ऋषि अरिष्टनेमि से पूछने की कथा कहते हैं कि मनुष्य स्वयं जन्मता, बढ़ता और मरता है और सन्तुष्ट व्यक्ति इसी लोक में मुक्त है।
summary.te: తనలాంటి రాజు పాలిస్తూ కూడా ఎలా ముక్తుడిగా ఉండగలడు, ఏ గుణాలతో ఆసక్తి పాశం నుండి విడుదలవుతాడని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. రాజు సగరుడు ఋషి అరిష్టనేమిని అడిగిన కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు; మనిషి స్వయంగా పుట్టి పెరిగి చస్తాడు, తృప్తుడే ముక్తుడు.
summary.ta: தன்னைப் போன்ற மன்னன் ஆளும்போதும் எவ்வாறு விடுபட்டிருக்க முடியும், எந்தக் குணங்களால் பற்றுப் பாசத்திலிருந்து விடுபடுவான் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, மன்னன் சகரன் முனிவர் அரிஷ்டநேமியிடம் கேட்ட கதையைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்; மனிதன் தானே பிறந்து வளர்ந்து இறக்கிறான், நிறைவுற்றவனே விடுபட்டவன்.
summary.ml: താനെപ്പോലെയുള്ള രാജാവ് സ്വതന്ത്രനായി എങ്ങനെ ഭരിക്കുമെന്നും, ആസക്തിയുടെ കെണിയിൽനിന്ന് ഏത് ഗുണങ്ങളാൽ മോചനം നേടാമെന്നും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. സഗരരാജാവ് അരിഷ്ടനേമി മുനിയോട് ചോദിച്ചതും, മനുഷ്യൻ സ്വയം ജനിക്കുകയും വളരുകയും അവസാനിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നുവെന്നും, ഈ ലോകത്ത് സംതൃപ്തനായ മനുഷ്യൻ ഇതിനകം സ്വതന്ത്രനാണെന്നും മുനി പഠിപ്പിച്ചതും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.277; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कथं नु मुक्तः पृथिवीं चरेदस्मद्विधो नृपः ।
नित्यं कैश्च गुणैर्युक्तः सङ्गपाशाद्विमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: How can a king like us, being free, move about the earth, and by what qualities, constantly practiced, is he released from the snare of attachment?

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम् ।
अरिष्टनेमिना प्रोक्तं सगरायानुपृच्छते ॥

meaning.en: On this I will relate to you an ancient account, spoken by Arishtanemi to Sagara, who questioned him.

verses.text: सगर उवाच

meaning.en: Sagara said:

verses.text:
किं श्रेयः परमं ब्रह्मन्कृत्वेह सुखमश्नुते ।
कथं न शोचेन्न क्षुभ्येदेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, what supreme good, once done, brings happiness here? How may one not grieve and not be disturbed? I wish to know this.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तार्क्ष्यः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ।
विबुध्य संपदं चाग्र्यां सद्वाक्यमिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, Tarkshya, learned in all the scriptures, recognized the excellence of the question and spoke these good words.

verses.text:
सुखं मोक्षसुखं लोके न च लोकोऽवगच्छति ।
प्रसक्तः पुत्रपशुषु धनधान्यसमाकुलः ॥

meaning.en: Happiness, the happiness of liberation, is not understood by people in the world, who cling to sons and cattle and are crowded with wealth and grain.

verses.text:
सक्तबुद्धिरशान्तात्मा न स शक्यश्चिकित्सितुम् ।
स्नेहपाशसितो मूढो न स मोक्षाय कल्पते ॥

meaning.en: One whose mind is attached and whose self is restless cannot be cured; the fool bound in the snare of affection is not fit for liberation.

verses.text:
स्नेहजानिह ते पाशान्वक्ष्यामि शृणु तान्मम ।
सकर्णकेन शिरसा शक्याश्छेत्तुं विजानता ॥

meaning.en: I will tell you of the snares born of affection here; listen to me. A knowing man can cut them with his own head, ears and all.

verses.text:
संभाव्य पुत्रान्कालेन यौवनस्थान्निवेश्य च ।
समर्थाञ्जीवने ज्ञात्वा मुक्तश्चर यथासुखम् ॥

meaning.en: When you have brought your sons up in due time, and settled them in married life, and know them capable of earning a living, wander free and as you please.

verses.text:
भार्यां पुत्रवतीं वृद्धां लालितां पुत्रवत्सलाम् ।
ज्ञात्वा प्रजहि काले त्वं परार्थमनुदृश्य च ॥

meaning.en: Knowing your wife, mother of sons, now old, pampered and fond of her children, dispose of her in due time, keeping in view the good of others.

verses.text:
सापत्यो निरपत्यो वा मुक्तश्चर यथासुखम् ।
इन्द्रियैरिन्द्रियार्थांस्त्वमनुभूय यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: With children or without, wander free and as you please, having enjoyed the objects of the senses with the senses, as prescribed.

verses.text:
कृतकौतूहलस्तेषु मुक्तश्चर यथासुखम् ।
उपपत्त्योपलब्धेषु लाभेषु च समो भव ॥

meaning.en: Having satisfied your curiosity about them, wander free and as you please, and be even-minded in gains obtained by fitting means.

verses.text:
एष तावत्समासेन तव संकीर्तितो मया ।
मोक्षार्थो विस्तरेणापि भूयो वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥

meaning.en: This I have briefly declared to you as the aim of liberation. Listen, and I will tell it again at greater length.

verses.text:
मुक्ता वीतभया लोके चरन्ति सुखिनो नराः ।
सक्तभावा विनश्यन्ति नरास्तत्र न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Free people, rid of fear, move about the world happily; people who are attached perish there, without doubt.

verses.text:
आहारसंचयाश्चैव तथा कीटपिपीलिकाः ।
असक्ताः सुखिनो लोके सक्ताश्चैव विनाशिनः ॥

meaning.en: Even insects and ants that store up food are happy in the world when unattached, and perish when attached.

verses.text:
स्वजने न च ते चिन्ता कर्तव्या मोक्षबुद्धिना ।
इमे मया विनाभूता भविष्यन्ति कथं त्विति ॥

meaning.en: One who wants liberation should not worry about his own people, thinking, "How will these fare without me?"

verses.text:
स्वयमुत्पद्यते जन्तुः स्वयमेव विवर्धते ।
सुखदुःखे तथा मृत्युं स्वयमेवाधिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: A creature is born by itself, grows by itself, and comes by itself to pleasure, pain and death.

verses.text:
भोजनाच्छादने चैव मात्रा पित्रा च संग्रहम् ।
स्वकृतेनाधिगच्छन्ति लोके नास्त्यकृतं पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Their food and clothing, and the support of mother and father, people obtain through what they themselves have done; in the world nothing arises that was not done before.

verses.text:
धात्रा विहितभक्ष्याणि सर्वभूतानि मेदिनीम् ।
लोके विपरिधावन्ति रक्षितानि स्वकर्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: All beings go about the earth on foods set out by the Creator, protected by their own deeds.

verses.text:
स्वयं मृत्पिण्डभूतस्य परतन्त्रस्य सर्वदा ।
को हेतुः स्वजनं पोष्टुं रक्षितुं वादृढात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Himself a lump of clay, always dependent on others, what reason has a person of weak self to feed or protect his own people?

verses.text:
स्वजनं हि यदा मृत्युर्हन्त्येव तव पश्यतः ।
कृतेऽपि यत्ने महति तत्र बोद्धव्यमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: When death kills your own people before your very eyes, though great effort was made, you must understand this for yourself.

verses.text:
जीवन्तमपि चैवैनं भरणे रक्षणे तथा ।
असमाप्ते परित्यज्य पश्चादपि मरिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Even a living kinsman, if you leave him before his upkeep and protection are completed, you will die later too.

verses.text:
यदा मृतश्च स्वजनं न ज्ञास्यसि कथंचन ।
सुखितं दुःखितं वापि ननु बोद्धव्यमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: When you are dead you will not know in any way whether your kin are happy or unhappy; surely you must understand this for yourself.

verses.text:
मृते वा त्वयि जीवे वा यदि भोक्ष्यति वै जनः ।
स्वकृतं ननु बुद्ध्वैवं कर्तव्यं हितमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Whether you are dead or alive, people will eat as they have earned; understanding this, you should do what is good for yourself.

verses.text:
एवं विजानँल्लोकेऽस्मिन्कः कस्येत्यभिनिश्चितः ।
मोक्षे निवेशय मनो भूयश्चाप्युपधारय ॥

meaning.en: Knowing this, and settled in the thought "who belongs to whom in this world?", set your mind on liberation and reflect on it again and again.

verses.text:
क्षुत्पिपासादयो भावा जिता यस्येह देहिनः ।
क्रोधो लोभस्तथा मोहः सत्त्ववान्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: The embodied one who has conquered hunger, thirst and the like, anger, greed and delusion, that person of strength is indeed liberated.

verses.text:
द्यूते पाने तथा स्त्रीषु मृगयायां च यो नरः ।
न प्रमाद्यति संमोहात्सततं मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: The man who never becomes heedless through infatuation in gambling, drink, women and hunting is liberated indeed.

verses.text:
दिवसे दिवसे नाम रात्रौ रात्रौ सदा सदा ।
भोक्तव्यमिति यः खिन्नो दोषबुद्धिः स उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who is weary at the thought that day after day, night after night, one must always eat, is said to have the insight that sees fault.

verses.text:
आत्मभावं तथा स्त्रीषु मुक्तमेव पुनः पुनः ।
यः पश्यति सदा युक्तो यथावन्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He who always, with discipline, sees again and again the true nature of the self in women as already free, is truly liberated.

verses.text:
संभवं च विनाशं च भूतानां चेष्टितं तथा ।
यस्तत्त्वतो विजानाति लोकेऽस्मिन्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He who knows truly the birth and destruction of beings and their activity is liberated in this world.

verses.text:
प्रस्थं वाहसहस्रेषु यात्रार्थं चैव कोटिषु ।
प्रासादे मञ्चकस्थानं यः पश्यति स मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who sees that a single measure of grain is enough among thousands of cartloads, and that for the journey, even among millions, only a seat on a couch in a palace is used, is freed.

verses.text:
मृत्युनाभ्याहतं लोकं व्याधिभिश्चोपपीडितम् ।
अवृत्तिकर्शितं चैव यः पश्यति स मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who sees the world struck by death, afflicted by diseases and worn down by lack of livelihood is freed.

verses.text:
यः पश्यति सुखी तुष्टो नपश्यंश्च विहन्यते ।
यश्चाप्यल्पेन संतुष्टो लोकेऽस्मिन्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He who sees this is happy and content, and one who does not is struck down; and he who is content with little is liberated in this world.

verses.text:
अग्नीषोमाविदं सर्वमिति यश्चानुपश्यति ।
न च संस्पृश्यते भावैरद्भुतैर्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He who sees that all this is Agni and Soma, and is not touched by wondrous states, is liberated indeed.

verses.text:
पर्यङ्कशय्या भूमिश्च समाने यस्य देहिनः ।
शालयश्च कदन्नं च यस्य स्यान्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: The embodied person for whom a couch and the bare ground are equal, and rice and poor food are equal, is liberated.

verses.text:
क्षौमं च कुशचीरं च कौशेयं वल्कलानि च ।
आविकं चर्म च समं यस्य स्यान्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He for whom linen, kusha-grass garments, silk, bark and sheepskin are all alike is liberated.

verses.text:
पञ्चभूतसमुद्भूतं लोकं यश्चानुपश्यति ।
तथा च वर्तते दृष्ट्वा लोकेऽस्मिन्मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He who sees the world as arisen from the five elements and acts accordingly in this world is liberated.

verses.text:
सुखदुःखे समे यस्य लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ ।
इच्छाद्वेषौ भयोद्वेगौ सर्वथा मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: He for whom pleasure and pain are the same, gain and loss, victory and defeat, desire and hatred, fear and agitation, is liberated in every way.

verses.text:
रक्तमूत्रपुरीषाणां दोषाणां संचयं तथा ।
शरीरं दोषबहुलं दृष्ट्वा चेदं विमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the body as a heap of blood, urine, feces and humors, full of faults, one is freed from it.

verses.text:
वलीपलितसंयोगं कार्श्यं वैवर्ण्यमेव च ।
कुब्जभावं च जरया यः पश्यति स मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who sees through old age the wrinkles and gray hair, the thinness, the discoloring and the stooping is freed.

verses.text:
पुंस्त्वोपघातं कालेन दर्शनोपरमं तथा ।
बाधिर्यं प्राणमन्दत्वं यः पश्यति स मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who sees, in time, the loss of manhood, the failing of sight, deafness and the weakening of breath is freed.

verses.text:
गतानृषींस्तथा देवानसुरांश्च तथा गतान् ।
लोकादस्मात्परं लोकं यः पश्यति स मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who sees that sages, gods and Asuras have gone from this world to another is freed.

verses.text:
प्रभावैरन्वितास्तैस्तैः पार्थिवेन्द्राः सहस्रशः ।
ये गताः पृथिवीं त्यक्त्वा इति ज्ञात्वा विमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Knowing that thousands of kings of the earth, endowed with all kinds of powers, have gone, leaving the earth, one is freed.

verses.text:
अर्थांश्च दुर्लभाँल्लोके क्लेशांश्च सुलभांस्तथा ।
दुःखं चैव कुटुम्बार्थे यः पश्यति स मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who sees that wealth is hard to obtain in the world, troubles easy to come by, and that family life brings sorrow is freed.

verses.text:
अपत्यानां च वैगुण्यं जनं विगुणमेव च ।
पश्यन्भूयिष्ठशो लोके को मोक्षं नाभिपूजयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing so often in the world the failings of children and of people generally, who would not hold liberation in honor?

verses.text:
शास्त्राल्लोकाच्च यो बुद्धः सर्वं पश्यति मानवः ।
असारमिव मानुष्यं सर्वथा मुक्त एव सः ॥

meaning.en: The man enlightened by scripture and by the world who sees all human life as empty is liberated in every way.

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा मम वचो भवांश्चरतु मुक्तवत् ।
गार्हस्थ्ये यदि ते मोक्षे कृता बुद्धिरविक्लवा ॥

meaning.en: Having heard my words, may you live like one liberated, if in household life your mind is firmly set on liberation.

verses.text:
तत्तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक्स पृथिवीपतिः ।
मोक्षजैश्च गुणैर्युक्तः पालयामास च प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: Having duly heard those words, that lord of the earth, endowed with the qualities born of liberation, ruled his subjects.
